recordScope: Historical snapshot at the first USB disconnection. Installation, restored settings and final strict tests are superseded by 2026-11-04-fold5-0.5.4.json; the original measurements below are retained.

continuousListening.skipReason: The isolated-history overlay test is restricted to emulators; actual Fold5 overlay is tested separately.

realQwen.input: Two distinct 5-second rain recordings, then eight repetitions of rainy French tickets/station speech with a 0.8-second internal breath and 2-second inter-clip gaps. Fixed samples, not the room microphone.

externalApplicationCaptions.longSpeechSource: Je voudrais deux billets. Excusez-moi, où est la gare?
externalApplicationCaptions.longSpeechTranslation: 我要两张票。不好意思，请问车站在哪里？

duplexSoft.input: Fixed French near voice at 0.14 gain, delayed returned TTS at 0.15-0.16 gain and continuous 140 Hz hum of amplitude 300. Actual Android player and Qwen provider; no live room microphone.
duplexSoft.followUp: Verify both exactly two turns and the entire quiet French question on the candidate. Do not treat a train keyword alone as full phrase accuracy.

candidate053.notInstalledReason: USB disconnected before the installer started; adb reported no devices.
candidate053.rootCause: With background hum, low-gain initial playback may fail the high-confidence one-frame match for most of the phrase. No acoustic reference is acquired until a loud syllable, so correlated playback can reach ASR.
candidate053.fix: Acquire the first path after 40 ms of consecutive matching delay and gain when the correlated waveform explains the input above the measured room floor. Keep the existing high-confidence match and subsequent path tracking.

coldEchoRegression.fixture: tickets-zh, train-zh, tickets-fr, train-fr bundled speech; 16 kHz input; 100 ms echo delay; 0.15 echo gain; 140 Hz hum amplitude 300; background RMS 212
coldEchoRegression.metric: Absolute projection of samples classified as possible voice onto known playback, divided by playback energy. Not transcription accuracy, loudness or a general environmental guarantee.

quietIndependentSpeechRegression.metric: Projection of filtered output onto known near speech during the opening half-second, divided by near speech energy.

harnessFinding: A real-cloud run stalled while invoking the local ONNX detector with the app in the background. A timed rerun reproduced the stack location. Opening the project launcher before the test made the same controlled run pass; this does not establish a general OEM cause.
privacy: Credentials remain inside the phone. All audio exported for this investigation is fixed test input or its generated translation, never room microphone audio. Test preferences are isolated and deleted; the external-caption test removes only its generated turns and restores the chosen source app.
